display_name: Speculative Evolution - alien ecosystem field-guide plates (AI stills only)
locked_model: klein (config/image_engine.json -> model); prompt target klein, variant C

line_style.name: flat-vector field-guide plate
line_style.prompt_phrase: flat vector illustration, field-guide plate, silhouette-first, clean geometric lines, flat fills
rules: one flat fill per surface, no gradients
no shading, no photographic depth, no texture rendering
outline weight constant across the plate

camera_vocabulary.front: full body straight from the front, symmetric, both flanks visible
camera_vocabulary.side: full body in profile, silhouette readable edge to edge
camera_vocabulary.three_quarter: full body at a three-quarter angle, near and far side readable
camera_vocabulary.detail_crop: close crop on one anatomy detail
camera_vocabulary.wide_context: wide establishing view of the habitat, subject small in frame

constraints.positive: clean image without text, text-free, no letters, no numerals, no watermark
flat vector rendering, not photorealistic, no photographic depth

constraints.negative: people, person, human figure, silhouette of a human

constraints.positive: no emblems, no insignia, no flags, no logos

constraints.negative: gradients, bloom, volumetric light, dramatic shadow

label_rule.label: Speculative illustration
label_rule.gate: every AI cut carries the label from the first frame and in the cut description

anatomy_rule.rule: the limb/eye/horn counts and the canonical silhouette are written into every prompt for that creature; a prompt without the counts is invalid

seed_policy.rule: one fixed seed per creature and view, recorded in the manifest; never reuse a seed for two subjects inside one batch

editorial_overlays_rule: labels, scale bars, arrows, maps and numbers are drawn in the editor, never by the image model

citations.title: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B model card (prompt style sensitivity, multi-reference editing)
